data.summary: As your Shooting phase begins, pick one enemy unit that this unit's Master of Ordnance model can see and that is no more than 30" from it; the same unit cannot be picked twice by this ability in one phase. Until the phase is over, Blast weapons that friendly ASTRA MILITARUM ARTILLERY models are equipped with gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1] whenever they target the picked unit.

combat.unresolved: An independent review against the official text found this reading wrong or incomplete; it stays withheld until a fix is reviewed again.
